text.tspan: Updated against the current model inventory
Rectangle = entity · Diamond = relationship · Oval = stored attribute · Underlined _id = identifier · Double oval = scalar array
(min,max) at an entity counts its participation with the opposite entity. A double connector denotes mandatory participation on that side.
Dashed recordId branches are alternatives selected by resource (XOR). Historical targets may no longer exist; these are logical references, not SQL foreign keys.
Project–Deal is optional 1:1 under the required unique partial index. Singleton settings, throttle buckets and the write lock have no entity-reference links.
